pkgmetadata.longdescription:
lxc-pve is the pxvirt fork of Linux Containers (LXC), patched for use with the pxvirt virtualization platform (a Proxmox VE fork for ARM64 and LoongArch). It includes security patches to harden AppArmor profiles, a fix for NSS-related segfaults in lxc-attach, and AppArmor profile updates to support user namespace creation and the abi directive.
This package conflicts with app-emulation/lxc (if that package were present in the Gentoo tree) and should be used in conjunction with app-emulation/pve-container for pxvirt-managed containers.

use.flag: Enable AppArmor MAC profile support for containers
Enable POSIX capabilities support via libcap
Build API documentation with Doxygen and man pages
Enable seccomp syscall filtering for containers
